items.title: Trump admin. urges Apple not to purchase Chinese memory chips, but this presents a problem
items.summary: US Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick says the Trump administration does not want Apple (AAPL) to purchase memory chips from China. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains why this presents issues for Apple.

items.title: 4 Memory Stocks Cramer Says Could Avoid an AI Bust and Keep Climbing
items.summary: Jim Cramer says Micron, SanDisk, Seagate, and Western Digital could keep climbing as AI memory demand persists.

items.title: Micron Reclaims $1,000 Amid Fresh Memory Momentum: Jim Cramer Says MU Stock Can ‘Double Again’
items.summary: Strong cloud growth and continued record data-center spending from Big Tech are fueling strength in the memory trade.

items.title: Micron and Western Digital Shares Are Soaring, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks jumped in the afternoon session after Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick told The Wall Street Journal the Trump administration opposes Apple buying Chinese memory chips.

items.title: Situational Awareness’ 13F Reveals an $11 Billion AI Bet That Unraveled in Under a Month
items.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner built one of the most concentrated AI bets in hedge fund history, and then watched it come apart in under a month in ways that forced a fire sale to a rival firm.

items.title: Stocks to Watch Recap: Alibaba, L3Harris, Diana Shipping, BHP
items.summary: ↗️ Alibaba (BABA, HK:9988): The Chinese company struck a $1.5 billion deal to sell its videogame business as it sharpens its focus on AI. Shares rose 1.9% in Hong Kong; its U.S.-listed ADRs ticked up 0.

items.title: Sandisk, Micron, Coherent, Boeing, Apple, Amazon, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Coherent is the best-performing stock in the S&P 500 on Monday. Sandisk, Micron, Marvell, and other AI stocks also rise.

items.title: U.S. Stocks Slip as Oil Impasse Weighs on Sentiment
items.summary: U.S. stocks ended modestly lower as an apparent impasse in Middle East peace talks offset a surge in AI-related shares.
